verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a payments platform that ships SDKs, an agent toolkit, an MCP server and consumer web and app surfaces, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics or tracking opt-out in PayPal's SDKs, MCP server, agent toolkit or account settings. The community item about PayPal demanding that a merchant monitor its own customers' traffic concerns a different subject and is not credited.
